slides.title: UN: 36,000 from Ethiopia now in Moyale, Kenya
slides.body: Local leaders in Marsabit County appeal for support.

slides.title: Who is arriving
slides.body: Mostly women and children, says the UN refugee agency (UNHCR). Some stay with relatives, others in camps and shelters. Kenya's rights commission counts about 40,000; figures differ and are not independently verified.

slides.title: Pressure on host towns
slides.body: Marsabit leaders say the arrivals could overwhelm local communities already short of food and water (AP). Kenya Red Cross says more food is now reaching the camps.

slides.title: Protect people seeking safety. Keep aid flowing.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
